### Headline summary
- Nvidia's board is preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang following reports of an affair, causing a stock drop and intensifying congressional scrutiny of the company's China ties. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-11/coreweave-sees-no-reason-that-nvidia-partnership-will-change), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261110/p66#a261110p66), [Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/former-cia-officer-says-what-nvidia-case-can-teach-companies-2026-11), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261111/p1#a261111p1))
- Anthropic is conducting an oversubscribed IPO roadshow while releasing the Claude Fable 5.2 model and new enterprise office tools. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261110/p60#a261110p60), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261110/p63#a261110p63), [Towards AI](https://pub.towardsai.net/i-ran-claude-fable-5-2-and-opus-5-5-on-the-same-5-coding-tasks-ae1f8c3c1087?source=rss----98111c9905da---4), [Towards AI](https://pub.towardsai.net/long-live-the-new-king-can-your-team-afford-to-keep-claude-fable-5-2-2f669161865b?source=rss----98111c9905da---4))
- Google DeepMind released AlphaGenome 2 and a new robotics model, while Google also launched the Gemini Decisions API and integrated Gemini into Apple CarPlay. ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1031524/google-deepmind-alphagenome-2-genetic-ai-model), [DeepMind Blog](https://deepmind.google/blog/alphagenome-2-deciphering-how-cells-read-dna-to-better-understand-disease/), [Vercel Blog](https://vercel.com/changelog/gemini-decision-1-now-available-on-ai-gateway), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/google-launches-gemini-decisions-api-for-multimodal-ai-workflows/))

### Nvidia CEO Scandal and Board Action
Nvidia's board is preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang following reports of an affair with an executive, causing the company's stock to fall and raising concerns about China ties. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-11/coreweave-sees-no-reason-that-nvidia-partnership-will-change), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261110/p66#a261110p66), [NYT > Technology](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/11/technology/jensen-huang-affair-lori-huang.html), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-11-11/nvidia-is-playing-out-like-a-greek-tragedy-goldberg-video))

### Congressional Scrutiny of Nvidia and China Ties
Congress is scrutinizing Nvidia's ties to China after H200 chips were found at a blacklisted Chinese university, with former CIA officers warning of underestimated intelligence risks. ([Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/former-cia-officer-says-what-nvidia-case-can-teach-companies-2026-11), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261111/p1#a261111p1), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/procurement-notices-detail-four-nvidia-h200-cards-at-blacklisted-nwpu/), [International Business Times](https://www.ibtimes.com/nvidia-h200-chips-blacklisted-chinese-university-3809642))

### Anthropic IPO Roadshow and Valuation
Anthropic's IPO is reported to be oversubscribed with a price hike, and the company is conducting a roadshow where CEO Dario Amodei discussed AI's potential to cure diseases. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261110/p60#a261110p60), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261110/p63#a261110p63), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/anthropic-opens-australian-retail-offer-for-its-planned-nasdaq-ipo/), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261111/p23#a261111p23))

### Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and new enterprise tools
Anthropic launched the Claude Fable 5.2 model, which outperforms Opus 5.5 on certain benchmarks, alongside new workplace tools including Claude Sheets and whiteboard capabilities. ([Towards AI](https://pub.towardsai.net/i-ran-claude-fable-5-2-and-opus-5-5-on-the-same-5-coding-tasks-ae1f8c3c1087?source=rss----98111c9905da---4), [Towards AI](https://pub.towardsai.net/long-live-the-new-king-can-your-team-afford-to-keep-claude-fable-5-2-2f669161865b?source=rss----98111c9905da---4), [International Business Times](https://www.ibtimes.com/microsoft-shares-fall-anthropic-office-ai-tools-3809631), [AI Business](https://aibusiness.com/generative-ai/anthropic-launches-new-ai-models))

### Google DeepMind Releases AlphaGenome 2
Google DeepMind released AlphaGenome 2, a model for variant effect prediction, alongside a new advanced robotics AI model. ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1031524/google-deepmind-alphagenome-2-genetic-ai-model), [DeepMind Blog](https://deepmind.google/blog/alphagenome-2-deciphering-how-cells-read-dna-to-better-understand-disease/), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261111/p32#a261111p32), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/google-deepminds-alphagenome-2-predicts-cell-state-variant-effects/))

### Google Launches Gemini Decisions API
Google introduced the Gemini Decisions API and the Gemini Decision 1 model, which is designed to score complex questions in a single pass. ([Vercel Blog](https://vercel.com/changelog/gemini-decision-1-now-available-on-ai-gateway), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/google-launches-gemini-decisions-api-for-multimodal-ai-workflows/), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261111/p40#a261111p40), [THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/google-joins-the-decision-model-wave-with-gemini-decision-1-scoring-1000-questions-in-a-single-pass/))

### United Airlines bans third-party AI agents from booking flights
United Airlines announced it will prevent personal AI assistants from booking tickets, citing data privacy risks and potential violations of FAA and DOT rules. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261111/p39#a261111p39), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-11/united-blocks-ai-agents-from-booking-flights-ahead-of-holidays), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/united-airlines-bars-unauthorized-ai-agents-from-booking-travel/), [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2314121/united-is-restricting-ai-agents-from-booking-flights/))

### OpenAI quarterly revenue reaches $10 billion
OpenAI's quarterly revenue has grown to $10 billion, a 50% increase driven by enterprise sales, though the company still trails Anthropic in some metrics. ([THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/enterprise-sales-push-openais-quarterly-revenue-to-10-billion-though-it-still-trails-anthropic/), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/11/openais-quarterly-revenue-reportedly-crosses-10b-for-the-first-time/))
